searchText: Created <#910910348922589184> to have a more focused testing channel for The Merge 🙂 Will we expect to see any traffic over the `engine_` RPC channel before the merge? As a node operator it'd be nice to know that that channel is alive and well since I imagine we'll deploy the merge-compatible layout weeks before the actual merge, ideally there'd be some sort of no-op message we could periodically or on-demand trigger to know that the CL and EL are still connected to one another. It could also maybe confirm that the two endpoints agree on chainId, TTD and some other basic sanity checks (edit: and merge spec "version").
